findings.text: The audits omit `byName_eq`, the only theorem that establishes the concrete `ada, bob` result, so that result could depend on a forbidden axiom while the check passes. Fix: Add `#print axioms byName_eq` and update the status record after rerunning the Nix check.

The diagnostic labels every axiom in the theorem’s closure as forbidden when even one is disallowed. Fix: Report only `axioms - STANDARD_AXIOMS` and tell the reader to remove those dependencies from the named theorem’s proof.
The subprocess deadlines are policy limits embedded in the compiler, probe, and benchmark calls. Fix: Give each distinct deadline a named, documented constant and use it at the corresponding call.

The module docstring says the baseline contains only imports, but the timed file also defines the row, bag, equality instance, and constructor. Fix: Describe the measurement as the best compilation wall time minus the best wall time for the same declarations without the equality proof.

The probe check can pass if SQLite prints the expected output and then hangs or crashes, because `|| true` discards the timeout or crash status. Fix: Capture the exit status, require the pinned shell’s expected status for the intentional SQL errors, and compare the transcript.
